headline: Wall Street falls on concerns over inflation and interest rates; Nvidia falls again
summary: US indexes retreated after inflation and GDP figures came in above expectations, alongside renewed tariff concerns. Nvidia shares fell again.
why: Equity indexes are sensitive to inflation data because it shapes expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate policy, which affects borrowing costs and equity valuations.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia shares fell again in the same broad sell-off.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Inflation and GDP figures above expectations raised concern about rate policy, while renewed tariff worries added pressure on stocks.
original_headline: Wall Street cae por preocupaciones sobre inflación y tasas de interés; Nvidia vuelve a caer
